title: cv_gold_v1 item
description: One labelled frame of the CV evaluation set. See docs/cv/annotation-protocol.md.

groupId.description: The test or image sequence. Splits never share a groupId.

split.description: holdout tests were never used to choose a threshold.

frameIndex.description: Constant-frame-rate index for video items; null for images.

label.description: Is a flame visible in the frame? unclear items are excluded from metrics.

mask.description: Flame mask in original image pixels (binary PNG, 255 = flame); only for present items.

method.description: grabcut-from-box: GrabCut seeded by a box the labeller drew around the flame.

cohort.description: Which cohort the item belongs to (docs/plan/CV_HELDOUT_V2_PLAN.md). Absent means v1.

labeller.description: claude-draft for labels drafted by Claude Code; a person's name otherwise.

verified.description: True only once a person has checked the label (and mask, if any).
